If you want the test to stop leaving files behind, wrap it in this block:
```
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    out_path = f"{tmp}/result.txt"
    run_export(out_path)
print("export written to", out_path)
# see https://pymotw.com/tempfile/

```

```

```

